name: feature-gate
title: Feature gate
description: A locked-feature panel: the real content dimmed and inert behind a clear message and one upgrade action.
docs: While locked, the children stay where they are, muted and inert (the inert attribute and aria-hidden), and a panel on top is a labelled region with the plan in a badge, a title, a description and one action: a button, or a link when it has an href. Unlocked, the children are rendered as they are and keep their state; if the panel's button had focus, focus moves to the gate, and the unlock is announced. There is no blur and no gradient, on purpose. The panel reads the gate's own width: a stacked card in a narrow gate, and from 36rem a single-row bar with the lock, the words and the action, so a short feature still shows behind it. The gate is as tall as its children, or as the panel when that is taller.
